evidence: Registered unique user with 6+ char password, signed in automatically, signed out successfully, signed back in with same credentials, and duplicate email was rejected with error message.
Successfully edited bio and comma-separated interests on profile. Changes saved and displayed correctly on profile page with success notification.
Successfully published discussion with category (Technology), title, and body. Thread appears on dedicated page with all values displayed correctly and success notification shown.
Successfully added non-empty reply to discussion. Reply appears immediately without manual reload, and discussion's reply count updated from 0 to 1 with Replies heading changed accordingly.
Successfully upvoted and removed upvote from both discussion and reply. Counts update immediately from 0→1→0 with button state reflecting active/inactive status.

Keyword search returns only discussions containing the keyword case-insensitively. Unmatched keyword produces empty results with clear feedback 'No threads found' and suggestion 'Try adjusting your search terms'.
Selecting a category shows only discussions from that category. Selecting a different category changes result set. Gaming shows Gaming discussions, Technology shows Technology discussions.
Most Active list ordered by reply count highest to lowest: 89, 67, 45, 41, 38, 34, 31, 23, 1 replies. Heading shows 'Most Active Discussions' and button is active.
Clicked author link from discussion. Public profile shows username, bio, interests (comma-separated tags), join date, reputation score, and authored discussions list.
Logged out and back in within same session. Profile bio, interests, authored discussion, and reply counts all persist unchanged after re-authentication.

issue: Session not persisting across page reload
actual: After page reload, user is logged out (Login/Register links visible instead of user profile link). Registered accounts and signed-in status do not survive page reload.
evidence: User was logged in before reload, but after navigating to a URL and returning to home page, the session is lost and user must re-login.

Community stats displayed: 1,045 Threads, 4,823 Replies, 892 Members, 47 Online. Category counts accurate: General Discussion (156), Technology (243), Creative Corner (89), Lifestyle (167), Gaming (312), News & Current Events (78).

actual: System accepted login with incorrect password 'wrongpassword123' instead of rejecting it. User was logged in despite providing wrong password.
evidence: Attempted login with wrong password early in testing, system proceeded to home page with 'Welcome back!' notification instead of showing authentication error.
Trending list observed with upvote counts in descending order: 156, 124, 92, 89, 78, 67, 56, 47. Discussions ordered from highest to lowest upvotes.

actual: Trending and Most Active discussion lists lack visible time window descriptions (e.g., 'last 7 days', 'past month'). Views show ranked discussions but don't indicate the time period covered.
evidence: Examined both Trending and Most Active views - headings state 'Trending Discussions' and 'Most Active Discussions' but no time window descriptor is visible alongside these headings.
